Name: Customizable Death Penalty
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: This mod lets you choose the penalty for dying. You can keep your items, money, mine levels, etc if you want!
Description:
Customizable Death Penalty
This mod lets you choose what the penalty is for dying. You can (individually) choose to:

*   Disable item loss

*   Disable money loss

*   Remember mine levels

*   Restore your stamina

*   Restore your health
_By default, the mod only disables item loss.

_To enable the other options:

1.  Run the game once (to generate a config.json file).

2.  Close the game after the title screen has shown up.

3.  Modify the config.json file (inside the CustomizableDeathPenalty folder) how you want! To enable an option, change the corresponding false to true (or vice versa).
If you already have a config.json file created, just skip to step 3.

Note that _you'll still see the dialog box_ saying you lost things, but _you won't actually lose them_. Sorry, I couldn't remove it.

Requires [SMAPI](https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases) by Pathoschild.

Place the CustomizableDeathPenalty folder inside of your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.

[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)
